learning_outcomes.text: Explain what quantum machine learning does and does not promise
Describe how classical data is encoded into quantum states
Outline variational quantum circuits and parameterised models
Describe quantum kernels and their relationship to classical kernels
Identify realistic near-term limitations and the role of hybrid approaches
Evaluate QML claims critically against classical baselines

integrative_case: A data science lead is asked whether to fund a quantum machine learning pilot: weigh the data-encoding bottleneck, the lack of a proven near-term advantage, and design an honest experiment that always reports a classical baseline.

case-based decisions in the integrative case
